Netflix Trailer Released for Gangster Drama 'Akka' Starring Keerthy Suresh and Radhika Apte

Netflix has released the trailer for its upcoming gangster drama titled 'Akka', featuring Keerthy Suresh and Radhika Apte. The trailer showcases a narrative centered on women's rule, the world of gangsters, and a quest for revenge, highlighting the powerful performances of the lead actresses.
